7.4.6 DTC significance
There are two different significance levels of DTCs:
• fault: classifies a failure, which relates to the component/ECU itself (and requires for example a repair action)
• occurrence: classifies an issue, which indicates additional information concerning insufficient system behavior (and relates for example to a condition out of the ECU’s control) This significance level is configurable per event (refer to DemDTCSignificance in DemDTCAttributes) and can be mapped as a data element (refer to DEM_SIGNIFICANCE).
